comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Corrupt (4-knob). build.py reads THIS file. Zero-crossing pitch track -> square master + sub octave + octave-up harmony, Tone low-pass to tame the harsh square edges.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).
fxid_comment: 0x01C6. Reverted from 477 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 477 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
